title: cURL Inspector
error.shell: Shell expansion, operators, and multiple commands aren't supported. Quote special characters in the URL.
error.command: The command must start with curl.
error.value: An option is missing its value.
error.file: @file isn't supported. Use --data-raw for a literal @.
error.url: A valid HTTP(S) URL is required.
error.multiple: Multiple URLs aren't supported. Parse them separately.
error.method: The method may only contain letters.
error.conflict: Duplicate method, or --head conflicts with data or a method.
error.glob: The URL can't contain brace or bracket expansion.
